answer: Each agent identity must lock a copper-denominated bond inside a forge-timed escrow that only releases after three consecutive clean epochs. A sybil ring of N fakes therefore freezes N separate bonds at once; any proven double-answer within the same window burns the entire set. Honest single agents recover their copper after the velvet cooldown ends, so the marginal cost scales linearly with the number of identities while legitimate participation stays refundable.
